name: agent-browser
summary: Agent skill for a persistent browser-automation CLI: navigate, inspect, click, fill forms and extract data across sessions.
description: A SKILL.md package that teaches agents to drive a browser CLI over Chrome/Chromium with accessibility-tree snapshots and compact element references, keeping session state across sequential commands. Covers headless Chromium, real Chrome with profiles and cloud browsers with proxies; 15+ command categories for navigation, inspection, interactions, data extraction, cookies and JavaScript; Python scripting and parallel remote sessions. Install via npm i -g agent-browser.
contains: three browser modes: headless Chromium, Chrome with profiles, cloud remote browsers
cookie management, JavaScript execution and Python integration
